connector.name: Ctxfile
connector.registryDescription: Local-first MCP server that snapshots your project's working state into one context object.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ctxfile. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.ctxfile, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NOTION_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Notion internal integration token (enables the Notion connector)
